H7940G.name: Sachar
H7940G.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H7940G.brief: Son of Obed-edom, a Levitical gatekeeper
H7940G.short: Sachar was a son of Obed-edom and a Levitical gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

H7967I.name: Shallum
H7967I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7967I.brief: Son of Sismai, descendant of Judah
H7967I.short: Shallum, the son of Sismai, was a descendant of Judah through the line of Jerahmeel.

H7967J.name: Shallum
H7967J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7967J.brief: Son of Josiah, king of Judah
H7967J.short: Shallum was a son of Josiah, king of Judah, and the brother of Jehoiakim and Zedekiah.

H7967K.name: Shallum
H7967K.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7967K.brief: Son of Shaul, descendant of Simeon
H7967K.short: Shallum was the son of Shaul and a descendant of Simeon.

H7967L.name: Shallum
H7967L.desc: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7967L.brief: High priest, son of Zadok and father of Hilkiah
H7967L.short: Shallum, also known as Meshullam, was a high priest during the time of the kings of Judah, serving as the son of Zadok and the father of Hilkiah.

H7967M.name: Shallum
H7967M.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H7967M.brief: Gatekeeper of the tabernacle during David's reign
H7967M.short: Shallum was a gatekeeper of the tabernacle during the reign of David, and his descendants continued to serve as gatekeepers in the temple.

H7967N.name: Shallum
H7967N.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7967N.brief: Ephraimite leader who opposed taking captives from Judah
H7967N.short: Shallum, along with other leaders from Ephraim, opposed the army of Israel taking captives from Judah during the reign of King Ahaz.

H7967G.name: Shallum
H7967G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7967G.brief: King of Israel who conspired against Zechariah
H7967G.short: Shallum, son of Jabesh, conspired against Zechariah, king of Israel, assassinated him, and succeeded him as king, reigning for one month.

H7967H.name: Shallum
H7967H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7967H.short: Shallum, the husband of Huldah the prophetess, was the keeper of the wardrobe during the reign of King Josiah.

H7967O.name: Shallum
H7967O.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7967O.brief: Singer who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time
H7967O.short: Shallum was one of the singers who had married a foreign woman and agreed to put her away during Ezra's reforms.

H7967P.name: Shallum
H7967P.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7967P.brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time
H7967P.short: Shallum was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and pledged to put her away during Ezra's reforms.

H7967R.name: Shallum
H7967R.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7967R.short: Shallum was the uncle of Jeremiah the prophet and the father of Hanamel, who sold a field to Jeremiah.

H7967S.name: Shallum
H7967S.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7967S.brief: Father of Maaseiah, keeper of the threshold
H7967S.short: Shallum was the father of Maaseiah, who was a keeper of the threshold during the time of Jeremiah the prophet.

H7967Q.name: Shallum
H7967Q.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7967Q.brief: Son of Hallohesh, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall
H7967Q.short: Shallum, the son of Hallohesh and ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, repaired a section of the city wall along with his daughters.

H7968.name: Shallum
H7968.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7968.brief: Son of Col-hozeh, repaired the Fountain Gate
H7968.short: Shallum, the son of Col-hozeh and ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the Fountain Gate and the wall of the Pool of Shelah during Nehemiah's rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

H7935H.name: Shecaniah
H7935H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7935H.short: Shecaniah, a Levite priest during the reign of King David.

H7935G.name: Shecaniah
H7935G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7935G.short: Shecaniah was a descendant of King David through Jeconiah and is mentioned in the genealogy of David's descendants after the Babylonian exile.

H7935I.name: Shecaniah
H7935I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7935I.short: Shecaniah, a Levite who assisted in distributing tithes during Hezekiah's reign.

H7935L.name: Shecaniah
H7935L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7935L.brief: Israelite who confessed marrying a foreign wife
H7935L.short: Shecaniah, an Israelite who admitted to marrying a foreign wife during Ezra's time.

H7935J.name: Shecaniah
H7935J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7935J.brief: Descendant of Parosh who returned from exile
H7935J.short: Shecaniah, a descendant of Parosh, who returned from Babylonian exile.

H7935K.name: Shecaniah
H7935K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7935K.brief: Descendant of Jahaziel who returned from exile
H7935K.short: Shecaniah, a descendant of Jahaziel, who returned from Babylonian exile.

H7935M.name: Shecaniah
H7935M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7935M.short: Shecaniah, whose daughter married Tobiah the Ammonite, an enemy of Nehemiah.

H7928H.name: Shechem
H7928H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7928H.short: Shechem, a son of Shemida, from the tribe of Manasseh.

H7927H.name: Shechem
H7927H.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7927H.brief: Founded the city where Dinah was raped
H7927H.short: Shechem, founder of a Hivite city where Jacob's daughter Dinah was raped.

H7928G.name: Shechem
H7928G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7928G.brief: Son of Gilead and Manassite clan
H7928G.short: Shechem, a son of Gilead and forefather of a Manassite clan.

H7974.name: Shelah
H7974.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7974.brief: Son of Arpachshad and ancestor of Abraham
H7974.short: Shelah, son of Arpachshad and ancestor of Abraham in Luke's genealogy.

H7956.name: Shelah
H7956.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7956.brief: Judah's youngest son and his descendants
H7956.short: Shelah, Judah's third son, and his descendants, the Shelanites.

H7977.name: Shilhi
H7977.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7977.short: Shilhi, the father of Azubah, who was the mother of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

H7906.name: Secu
H7906.brief: Place near Ramah visited by Saul
H7906.short: Secu was a place near Ramah where Saul went in search of David (<ref="1Sam. 19:22">1Sam. 19:22</ref>).

H7996.name: Shallecheth
H7996.brief: Gate in Jerusalem assigned to Shuppim and Hosah
H7996.short: Shallecheth was a gate in Jerusalem assigned to the Levites Shuppim and Hosah for guard duty (<ref="1Chr. 26:16">1Chr. 26:16</ref>).

H7927G.name: Shechem
H7927G.brief: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim
H7927G.short: Shechem was a prominent city in Canaan, later allotted to the tribe of Ephraim, and the site of important events in Israel's history (<ref="Gen. 12:6; 33:18-20; Josh. 20:7; 24:1, 25-26; Judg. 9; 1Ki. 12:1, 25; Ps. 60:6; 108:7; Act.7.16">Gen. 12:6; 33:18-20; Josh. 20:7; 24:1, 25-26; Judg. 9; 1Ki. 12:1, 25; Ps. 60:6; 108:7; Act.7.16</ref>).

H7975A.name: Shelah
H7975A.short: Shelah, also called Shiloah, the King's Pool, or Siloam, was a pool in Jerusalem fed by the Gihon Spring via Hezekiah's Tunnel (<ref="Neh. 3:15; Isa. 8:6; Neh. 2:14; Luke 13:4; Jhn.9.7, 11">Neh. 3:15; Isa. 8:6; Neh. 2:14; Luke 13:4; Jhn.9.7, 11</ref>).

H7942.name: Shikkeron
H7942.brief: Town on the border of Judah
H7942.short: Shikkeron was a town on the northern border of Judah's territory, near Mount Baalah (<ref="Josh. 15:11">Josh. 15:11</ref>).
